amends.rule: The plan bytes remain immutable; this later amendment supersedes only inconsistent X1 model and matrix method clauses.

claim_boundary: Four lightweight governed CUDA model artifacts on one Windows/WSL2 physical node, one RTX 4080, and one Triton GPU runtime; no production capacity, SLA, HA/DR, multi-node, multi-GPU, MIG, MPS, or tenant-isolation claim.

dependency_gate.acceptance_execution: forbidden until the authoritative append-only ledger's latest S6B-M event is verified, acceptance_credit=true, independently signed off, and bound to an exact public closure SHA-256 and source revision/tree tuple

non_credit_execution.CANDIDATE: derive and append X1 load candidates and the exact ten P5 cell semantics from measured GPU-ms, API capacity, and CPU-worker capacity; V3 35 RPS is not an input
non_credit_execution.HOT_GUARD: reject any candidate that does not preserve measurable non-hot terminal progress and bounded queue/deadline outcomes
non_credit_execution.P0: four-model solo calibration, three repetitions per model, exact total 12
non_credit_execution.P1: forced-serial BAL80 mixed-model control, exact total 3
non_credit_execution.PROFILER: three parseable profiler repetitions; kernel overlap may be claimed only from distinct model/request kernel intervals
non_credit_execution.Q0: prove nonzero actual CUDA activity independently for every exact model artifact; any silent CPU fallback is invalid
